ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) on the left lobe; high-contrast mixed-intensity on the right lobe with an approximate white-to-black ratio of 1:3 across the total visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by a contiguous dark-intensity mass (pixels < 50 intensity value). Right lobe features a white substrate (pixels > 200) punctuated by distinct, low-intensity circular and irregular mottling blobs concentrated in the lower-right and central-right regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 38 degrees and a narrow vertex depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-tooth serrations along the superior boundary of both lobes, characterized by sharp peaks and jagged valleys with varying pixel-amplitude.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Steep concave curve ascending from the median notch, transitioning to a convex outward sweep at the distal margins toward the lobe tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of low-intensity circular spots (mottling) on the right lobe; high-contrast white/tan circular clusters representing barnacle colonization on the lateral leading edges.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle clusters (rosettes) localized along the leading edges and distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between the predominantly dark left lobe and the heavily mottled white right lobe.
